prompt: Write to a walking-group organizer suggesting a route with more benches. Frame the suggestion around making the outing comfortable for a wider range of participants. Use approximately 80 words for the response.
text: Could we consider a route with more benches or regular resting points? This would make the outing more comfortable and welcoming for a wider range of participants, including those who may appreciate occasional breaks due to mobility, stamina, or simply wanting time to enjoy the surroundings. A bench-friendly route could help everyone feel able to join at their own pace while keeping the walk social and inclusive.
